notes.title: New big update 2.0
notes.content:
Hello there,

Thanks everyone for playing Tiny Hunter!

Since the release, I have received a lot of positive feedback and  improvement requests in order to make
the game better.

So I heard you and I made some important updates that I will share with you now:


- A completely revisited physics system, in order to provide a better feeling of movement.

- The levels completely readjusted to have something less labyrinth and more airy.

- Several controllers keys to perform the same actions, which allows everyone to play comfortably and with his habits.

- The bosses were redone to have an increasing difficulty more interesting to understand throughout the course

- The jetpack (for those they knew) has been removed in order to limit the imputs'number and to improve control during speed runs.

- All the times of speedruns mode are redone

- I redid some graphic elements (like bumpers and fans)

- I also brought several different colors to dress the levels.
